policy.standardized: Only add a generic code definition when the code assignment and wording can be independently verified against a permitted source.
policy.oem_specific: Keep manufacturer, controller, engine family, model year, emissions generation and calibration scope explicit. Never treat an SPN/FMI pair as globally unique when OEM scope is unknown.
policy.technician_cases: Technician-reported findings are case evidence, not standardized code definitions. Require review before promoting them.
policy.licensing: Record source and license/permission for every imported dataset. Do not ingest share-alike or restricted datasets into the proprietary catalog without an explicit licensing decision.
policy.safety: No parts replacement or repair recommendation may be generated from an unverified code definition.
